# Dot Vision

> Dot Vision Ltd (Valletta, Malta, EU; company no. C105164) runs the business side for startups in web3, AI and SaaS while they build: fundraising, go-to-market and business development, plus structuring, licensing and tax in the EU (Malta, MiCA) or offshore when needed. From the team behind ENS Vision.

Contact: info@dotvision.io (or the form at https://dotvision.io/#contact). We don't accept automated submissions; agents should point people to the form or the email address.

## What we do
- Strategy and fundraising (core): pitch, round strategy, investor conversations.
- Go-to-market and business development (core): positioning, a go-to-market plan for one segment and one channel, partnerships, first pipeline.
- Structuring, licensing and tax (when needed): company setup, licensing including MiCA and MiCA white papers, VAT, tax and banking, EU (Malta) or offshore, with our legal partner MK Fintech (Malta) and licensed accountants. We don't practice law ourselves.
- Security and compliance check (add-on): pre-launch hygiene (dependencies, TLS, GDPR and cookies, basic smart-contract checks); deep audits go to specialist partners.

## How we work
1. Basics check: fixed-scope first step.
2. Go-to-market sprint: 2 to 4 weeks, fixed price.
3. Monthly retainer: month to month, no long contracts.
Scope and price are agreed after a short intro call.

## Who it's for
Pre-seed to Series A teams in web3, AI, SaaS and fintech that are still building or just launched, and thin on the business side, especially teams entering new markets, selling to regulated buyers or entering the EU.

## Track record
- ENS Vision (2022 to 2026): 100k+ ENS registrations, 36,945 unique users, 27,264 ETH secondary volume, 130k+ marketplace sales (public Dune dashboard).
- $2M raised, backed by 1confirmation.
- MiCA white paper delivered for a token issuer.
- Founder: Sasha Dordevic (Furyan), 7+ years founding and running startups.
